description: Freeze the arena spawner, remove pre-test hostiles, protect the arena, and reset the named Bot for controlled combat tests.
commands: item replace entity {{bot}} armor.head with minecraft:iron_helmet
item replace entity {{bot}} armor.chest with minecraft:iron_chestplate
item replace entity {{bot}} armor.legs with minecraft:iron_leggings
item replace entity {{bot}} armor.feet with minecraft:iron_boots
